arXiv:2605.31500v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 5 月 29 日arXiv:2605.31500v1 [cs.LG] 29 May 2026

通过 IO 感知层实现有效扩展 GNNOn Efficient Scaling of GNNs via IO-Aware Layers Implementations

Daria Fomina    Daniil Krasylnikov    Alexey Boykov    Andrey Dolgovyazov    Vyacheslav Zhdanovskiy    Fedor Velikonivtsev
摘要Abstract

图神经网络 (GNN) 受到稀疏、不规则的内存访问的瓶颈。 DGL 和 PyTorch Geometric 等流行框架支持一般消息传递，但复杂的层通常会实现边缘中间体，从而增加内存流量并限制大型图的可扩展性。 我们采用以 I/O 和算术强度为中心的视图，并表明广泛使用的层分为三个内核系列：基于 SpMM 的卷积、基于缩减的聚合和基于注意力的层（GATv2/Graph Transformer）。对于每个系列，我们都开发了 GPU 内核，可以减少数据移动、改善局部性并在实际图形中保持稳健性。我们还研究了图重新排序，发现它的影响取决于内核映射：它比特征并行设计更一致地有利于邻居并行（聚集主导）内核。 根据经验，我们的融合注意力内核达到Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are bottlenecked by sparse, irregular memory access. Popular frameworks such as DGL and PyTorch Geometric support general message passing, but complex layers often materialize edge-wise intermediates, increasing memory traffic and limiting scalability on large graphs. We take an I/O- and arithmetic-intensity–centric view and show that widely used layers fall into three kernel families: SpMM-based convolutions, reduction-based aggregations, and attention-based layers (GATv2/Graph Transformer). For each family, we develop GPU kernels that reduce data movement, improve locality, and remain robust across realistic graphs. We also study graph reordering and find that its impact depends on the kernel mapping: it benefits neighbor-parallel (gather-dominated) kernels more consistently than feature-parallel designs. Empirically, our fused attention kernels reach up to3.9×\timesGraph Transformer 的加速比（中位数speedup for Graph Transformer (median1.6×\times），Tensor Core（块稀疏）变体高达), with Tensor Core (block-sparse) variants up to7.3×\times在局部密集图上；对于 GATv2，我们达到on locally dense graphs; for GATv2 we reach up to8.5×\times加速比（中值speedup (median2.0×\times）同时减少峰值内存高达) while reducing peak memory by up to76×\times（中位数(median6×\times）。我们的程度感知缩减内核达到). Our degree-aware reduction kernels achieve up to10×\times加速比（中值speedup (median2.6×\times）。对于基于 SpMM 的层，正确缓存的 cuSPARSE 可以达到). For SpMM-based layers, properly cached cuSPARSE achieves up to8×\times比 DGL 加速，并且在大多数评估中优于评估的自定义基线。 我们将我们的实现作为直接替代品发布在我们的speedup over DGL and outperforms evaluated custom baselines in the majority of evaluations. We release our implementations as drop-in replacements in ourGitHub repository支持可重复的、硬件感知的 GNN 加速。to support reproducible, hardware-aware GNN acceleration.

机器学习、ICML、CUDA、GNN、加速、图、图机器学习Machine Learning, ICML, CUDA, GNN, Acceleration, Graphs, Graph Machine Learning

1 简介Introduction

图神经网络 (GNN) 是学习关系数据和非结构化数据的核心工具，可应用于推荐和欺诈检测、时空预测和科学模拟等领域Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are a core tool for learning over relational and unstructured data, with applications in recommendation and fraud detection, spatiotemporal forecasting, and scientific simulation and more(Lam et al., 2023; Shi et al., 2023; Pfaff et al., 2021; Fey et al., 2023; Sanchez-Gonzalez et al., 2020)。尽管模型设计取得了快速进展，但现代 GPU 上的 GNN 的训练和推理性能往往落后于密集的深度学习工作负载。一个关键原因是占主导地位的 GNN 算子是稀疏且不规则的：邻域聚合和注意力通过数据依赖、排列不变的访问模式遍历图边缘，导致算术强度低和局部性有限. Despite rapid progress in model design, training and inference performance of GNNs on modern GPUs often lags behind dense deep learning workloads. A key reason is that dominant GNN operators are sparse and irregular: neighborhood aggregation and attention traverse graph edges with data-dependent, permutation-invariant access patterns, leading to low arithmetic intensity and limited locality(Zhang et al., 2021; Peng et al., 2024).

硬件趋势进一步放大了这一差距。现代 GPU 的峰值计算吞吐量和 HBM 带宽之间的差距越来越大，从而将更多内核推入内存限制状态，除非它们对每个移动字节执行大量计算工作。用屋顶线术语来说，山脊点（受计算限制所需的算术强度）转向更高的值This gap is amplified by hardware trends. Modern GPUs exhibit a widening separation between peak compute throughput and HBM bandwidth, pushing more kernels into the memory-bound regime unless they perform substantial computational work per byte moved. In roofline terms, the ridge point (arithmetic intensity required to become compute-bound) shifts to higher values111作为参考，A100 SXM-4 有For reference, A100 SXM-4 has≈\approx312 TFLOP（FP16/BF16 张量核心）和312 TFLOPs (FP16/BF16 Tensor Cores) and≈\approx2 TB/s HBM 带宽（2 TB/s HBM bandwidth (≈\approx156 次浮点运算/字节）； H100 SXM-5 有156 FLOPs/byte); H100 SXM-5 has≈\approx1980 TFLOP 和1980 TFLOPs and≈\approx3.35 TB/秒（3.35 TB/s (≈\approx592 次浮点运算/字节）。592 FLOPs/byte).。因此，仅减少 FLOP 次数通常并不能转化为挂钟加速. As a result, reducing FLOPs alone often does not translate into wall-clock speedups(Zhang et al., 2025)。这种不匹配在 Transformer Attention 中有详细记录，其中 IO 感知算法可以显式减少 HBM. This mismatch is well documented in transformer attention, where IO-aware algorithms that explicitly reduce HBM↔\leftrightarrowSRAM 流量带来巨大的实际收益SRAM traffic deliver large practical gains(Dao et al., 2022; Dao, 2023; Shah et al., 2024; Ivanov et al., 2021)。我们认为，类似的缺失原则阻碍了可扩展的 GNN 加速：许多实现优先考虑算子通用性，而未充分优化数据移动和中间物化，使得性能越来越受到内存流量的支配. We argue that a similar missing principle hinders scalable GNN acceleration: many implementations prioritize operator generality, while under-optimizing data movement and intermediate materialization, making performance increasingly dominated by memory traffic(Zhang et al., 2021).

现有的 GNN 软件堆栈通常遵循两种方法之一。 Deep Graph Library (DGL) 和 PyTorch Geometric 等框架提供了通用的消息传递接口和优化的稀疏基元Existing GNN software stacks typically follow one of two approaches. Frameworks such as Deep Graph Library (DGL) and PyTorch Geometric provide a general message-passing interface and optimized sparse primitives(Wang et al., 2019; Fey et al., 2025)，但典型的层仍然可能会实现大型边缘中间体，从而增加内存流量和峰值激活足迹。在另一个极端，专门的算子实现可能需要大量的每层工程，并且可能无法始终从跨不同图形和特征大小的新硬件功能中受益, but typical layers may still materialize large edge-wise intermediates, increasing both memory traffic and peak activation footprint. At the other extreme, specialized operator implementations can require substantial per-layer engineering and may not consistently benefit from new hardware features across diverse graphs and feature sizes(Liu et al., 2024; Xiang et al., 2025).

最近的工作通过自适应运行时间和调度解决了这些问题Recent work addresses these issues via adaptive runtimes and scheduling(Wang et al., 2021)，特定层更高效的实现, more efficient implementations for specific layers(Peng et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2021)，以及将稀疏工作负载映射到张量核心的结构化稀疏格式, and structured sparsity formats that map sparse workloads onto Tensor Cores(Wang et al., 2023; Xiang et al., 2025; Li and Chandramowlishwaran, 2025)。然而，这些方法通常针对运算符的子集，需要重要的预处理/自定义格式，并且可能对图结构和度分布敏感。. However, these approaches often target a subset of operators, require nontrivial preprocessing/custom formats, and can be sensitive to graph structure and degree distribution.

在这项工作中，我们采用以 I/O 和算术强度为中心的 GNN 计算视图，并表明广泛使用的层聚集成具有不同硬件行为的三个内核系列： (i) 基于稀疏密集矩阵乘法（基于 SpMM）的卷积（例如 GCN/GraphConv）， (ii) 基于缩减的聚合（例如，In this work, we take an I/O- and arithmetic-intensity–centric view of GNN computation and show that widely used layers cluster into three kernel families with distinct hardware behavior: (i) sparse–dense matrix multiplications-based (SpMM-based) convolutions (e.g., GCN/GraphConv), (ii) reduction-based aggregations (e.g.,min\min/max\max以及相关部门的削减）， (iii) 复杂的工作流程，例如基于注意力的层（例如 GATv2 和图转换器）。 对于每个系列，我们分析常见实现的内存行为，并通过对具有不同密度和程度分布的真实图形进行分析来验证我们的设计。and related segment reductions), and (iii) complex workflows like attention-based layers (e.g., GATv2 and Graph Transformers). For each family, we analyze memory behavior of common implementations and validate our designs by profiling across realistic graphs with varying density and degree distributions.

这会产生三个可行的结果。首先，This yields three actionable outcomes. First,我们的实验表明our experiments show对于基于 SpMM 的卷积，供应商原语仍然具有高度竞争力：that for SpMM-based convolutions vendor primitives remain highly competitive:CUSPARSEcuSPARSE通常匹配或优于框架基线，并且缓存图预处理和转置邻接可改善向后传递的端到端延迟。第二，often matches or outperforms framework baselines, and caching graph preprocessing and a transposed adjacency improves end-to-end latency for the backward pass. Second,我们凭经验发现we empirically find对于基于缩减的层，度感知平铺在重尾度分布下至关重要，可以在不增加内存占用的情况下提高高度节点上的吞吐量，而简单的合并布局足以满足低度节点的需求。第三，对于基于注意力的层，我们贡献了受 FlashAttention 启发的 IO 感知内核，该内核融合了邻域计算，避免实现边缘中间中间体，并可选择通过块稀疏布局利用 Tensor Core。that for reduction-based layers degree-aware tiling is crucial under heavy-tailed degree distributions, improving throughput on high-degree nodes without increasing memory footprint, while a simple coalesced layout suffices for low-degree nodes. Third, for attention-based layers, we contribute FlashAttention-inspired IO-aware kernels that fuse neighbor-wise computation, avoid materializing edge-wise intermediates, and optionally leverage Tensor Cores via block-sparse layouts.

我们还重新审视图重新排序，并表明其有效性取决于内核并行化策略和度分布：邻居并行设计在高度图上受益更多，而在低度图（即道路网络）上影响有限，性能主要由每个节点的开销决定。最后，我们发布了一个具有最小依赖性的开源实现（CUDA、PyTorch、We also revisit graph reordering and show that its effectiveness depends on the kernel parallelization strategy and degree distribution: neighbor-parallel designs benefit more on high-degree graphs, whereas on low-degree graphs (i.e. road networks) the impact is limited and performance is dominated by per-node overheads. Finally, we release an open-source implementation with minimal dependencies (CUDA, PyTorch,CUSPARSEcuSPARSE）和 PyTorch 接口作为广泛使用的 GNN 层的直接替代品。) and a PyTorch interface as drop-in replacements for widely used GNN layers.

2.3 GNN 后端和 GNN 加速的先前工作GNN backends and prior work on GNN acceleration

PyTorch 使用最广泛的两个 Graph-ML 框架是 Deep Graph Library (DGL) 和 PyTorch Geometric (PyG)。 DGL 公开了一个以图为中心的 API，并通过两个广义稀疏基元实现 GNN 层：用于节点聚合的广义 SpMM (gSpMM) 和用于边缘计算的广义采样稠密矩阵乘法 (gSDDMM)。在其 CUDA 后端中，DGL 通常在目标节点上并行化 gSpMM，在边缘上并行化 gSDDMMTwo of the most widely used Graph-ML frameworks for PyTorch are Deep Graph Library (DGL) and PyTorch Geometric (PyG). DGL exposes a graph-centric API and implements GNN layers via two generalized sparse primitives: generalized SpMM (gSpMM) for node-wise aggregation and generalized sampled dense–dense matrix multiplication (gSDDMM) for edge-wise computations. In its CUDA backend, DGL typically parallelizes gSpMM over destination nodes and gSDDMM over edges(Wang et al., 2019)。 PyG 遵循 PyTorch 原生设计，通常通过分散/聚集减少和轻量级 CUDA 扩展来实现消息传递，为通用消息传递层提供灵活的接口. PyG follows a PyTorch-native design and usually implements message passing with scatter/gather reductions and lightweight CUDA extensions, offering a flexible interface for general message passing layers(Matthias et al., 2025).

虽然 DGL 为这些原语提供了高效的操作员级内核（例如，通过While DGL provides efficient, operator-level kernels for these primitives (e.g., viadgl.ops），更复杂的层通常表示为 gSDDMM 和 gSpMM 的组合，这会导致中间边缘消息具体化，并随后在), more complex layers are often expressed as a composition of gSDDMM and gSpMM, which results in materializing intermediate edge messages and subsequently reducing them duringAGG\mathrm{AGG}和复杂的and complexMSG\mathrm{MSG}在这两个框架中，都会增加内存流量和峰值激活足迹。实际上，DGL 通过优化的基元级内核减轻了部分开销，但复合层的具体化仍然很常见。此外，通过自动编译融合此类管道并非易事，因为计算在边缘并行和节点并行阶段之间交替，因此很难在整个层上保持局部性和负载平衡in both frameworks, increasing memory traffic and peak activation footprint. In practice, DGL mitigates part of this overhead with optimized primitive-level kernels, but materialization remains common for composite layers. Moreover, fusing such pipelines via automatic compilation is non-trivial, since the computation alternates between edge-parallel and node-parallel phases, making it difficult to preserve both locality and load balance across the entire layer(Zhang et al., 2021).

之前在 GPU 上加速 GNN 的工作涉及供应商库、稀疏内核原语、面向融合的系统和图形/格式转换。在供应商方面，NVIDIA cuSPARSE 提供高度优化的稀疏线性代数（特别是 SpMM），并作为基于 SpMM 的 GNN 层的强大基线。然而，通用 SpMM 不涵盖归约和注意力算子，它们的性能很大程度上取决于并行化选择、中间物化和内存局部性。 cuGraph 同样在 RAPIDS 生态系统中公开 GPU 图形基元和面向 GNN 的组件。Prior work on accelerating GNNs on GPUs spans vendor libraries, sparse-kernel primitives, fusion-oriented systems, and graph/format transformations. On the vendor side, NVIDIA cuSPARSE provides highly optimized sparse linear algebra (notably SpMM) and serves as a strong baseline for SpMM-based GNN layers. However, reduction and attention operators are not covered by generic SpMM and their performance depends strongly on parallelization choices, intermediate materialization, and memory locality. cuGraph similarly exposes GPU graph primitives and GNN-oriented components within the RAPIDS ecosystem.

除了供应商库之外，GE-SpMM 还提出了针对 GNN 使用量身定制的 CSR 原生 SpMM 内核，并引入了合并行缓存和扭曲级技术来改善内存行为Beyond vendor libraries, GE-SpMM proposes CSR-native SpMM-like kernels tailored to GNN usage and introduces coalesced row caching and warp-level techniques to improve memory behavior(Huang et al., 2020)。自适应稀疏切片通过行内重新排序改进了 CSR 内 SpMM/SDDMM 的局部性，以实现切片和数据重用. Adaptive sparse tiling improves locality for SpMM/SDDMM within CSR via intra-row reordering to enable tiling and data reuse(Hong et al., 2019)。稀疏 GPU 内核的经典分析（例如基于缓存的 GPU 上的 CSR SpMV）强调局部性、参数化映射和（自动）调整的作用，这些在解释现代 GNN 工作负载中的缓存效果和图形重新排序时仍然相关. Classical analyses of sparse GPU kernels (e.g., CSR SpMV on cache-based GPUs) emphasize the role of locality, parameterized mappings, and (auto-)tuning, which remain relevant when interpreting cache effects and graph reordering in modern GNN workloads(Reguly and Giles, 2012).

互补系列的目标是端到端执行图和融合。 FuseGNN、Fused3S 和相关管道通过融合常见算子序列（例如，用于稀疏注意力的 SDDMM–softmax–SpMM）来减少内核启动开销和中间张量A complementary line targets end-to-end execution graphs and fusion. FuseGNN, Fused3S, and related pipelines reduce kernel-launch overheads and intermediate tensors by fusing common operator sequences (e.g., SDDMM–softmax–SpMM for sparse attention)(Li and Chandramowlishwaran, 2025; Chen et al., 2020)。 DF-GNN 根据操作结构和度数偏差（包括超级节点）调整融合和线程调度. DF-GNN adapts fusion and thread scheduling to operation structure and degree skew, including super-nodes(Liu et al., 2024)。 GNNAdvisor 通过协调计算/IO/内存镜头来研究计算图，并提出算子重组、用于跨顶点/边阶段融合的统一线程映射以及重新计算以减少激活足迹. GNNAdvisor studies computational graphs through a coordinated computation/IO/memory lens and proposes operator reorganization, unified thread mapping for fusion across vertex/edge phases, and recomputation to reduce activation footprint(Wang et al., 2021)。缓存操作符重新排序探索了缓存的替代执行顺序，尽管公共实现并不总是可用. Cached Operator Reordering explores alternative execution orders with caching, though public implementations are not always available(Bazinska et al., 2023)。 MaxK-GNN 代表算法-系统协同设计，可修改表示以减少内存流量并启用定制内核. MaxK-GNN represents algorithm–system co-design that modifies representations to reduce memory traffic and enable tailored kernels(Peng et al., 2024).

最后，一些作品通过格式/图形转换来利用专用 GPU 单元。 TC-GNN 和 cuTeSpMM 通过结构化分块探索 SpMM 的密集 Tensor Core，并引入与 Tensor-Core 加速何时有益的结构相关标准Finally, several works leverage specialized GPU units via format/graph transformations. TC-GNN and cuTeSpMM explore dense Tensor Cores for SpMM through structured blocking and introduce structure-dependent criteria for when Tensor-Core acceleration is beneficial(Wang et al., 2023; Xiang et al., 2025)。 RT-GNN 通过对图重新排序以更好地匹配结构化稀疏性约束来瞄准稀疏张量核心；其实际影响取决于重新排序成本、兼容性约束以及评估的设置与真实端到端管道的匹配程度. RT-GNN targets Sparse Tensor Cores by reordering graphs to better match structured sparsity constraints; its practical impact depends on reordering cost, compatibility constraints, and how closely evaluated settings match real end-to-end pipelines(Yan et al., 2025).

2.4 针对局部性的图形重新排序Graph reordering for locality

图形重新排序应用排列Graph reordering applies a permutationπ\pi节点索引，通过将频繁共同访问的节点放置在更靠近内存的位置来提高缓存局部性。经典方法包括 METIS 式分区和填充减少排序to node indices to improve cache-locality by placing frequently co-accessed nodes closer in memory. Classic methods include METIS-style partitioning and fill-reducing orderings(Karypis and Kumar, 1997)。在 GNN 中，重新排序可以减少内存流量并改善通用框架中的端到端运行时间. In GNNs, reordering can reduce memory traffic and improve end-to-end runtime in general frameworks(Merkel et al., 2024)。在本文中，我们表明它的好处不是普遍的：效果取决于内核的内存访问模式（特征并行与邻居并行）和图结构。特别是，对于低度节点，每个节点的工作集很小，潜在的局部性改进是有限的。. In this paper, we show that its benefit is not universal: the effect depends on the kernel’s memory access pattern (feature-parallel vs. neighbor-parallel) and graph structure. In particular, for low-degree nodes, the per-node working set is small and the potential locality improvement is limited.

2.5 硬件特性和性能注意事项Hardware characteristics and performance considerations

我们专注于 GPU，因为它们是现代 GNN 训练和推理的主要平台。下面讨论的定性性能考虑因素扩展到其他面向吞吐量的加速器。We focus on GPUs, as they are the dominant platform for training and inference of modern GNNs. The qualitative performance considerations discussed below extend to other throughput-oriented accelerators.

CUDA 执行模型和 GPU 内存层次结构。CUDA Execution model and GPU memory hierarchy.GPU 程序（内核）由大量线程执行，这些线程被分组为调度在流式多处理器 (SM) 上的线程束和线程块。GPU programs (kernels) are executed by massive number of threads grouped into warps and thread blocks scheduled on streaming multiprocessors (SMs).

现代 GPU 公开了深层内存层次结构，以容量换取带宽和延迟。片上资源（寄存器、共享内存和 L1 缓存）在 SM 内共享，比全局高带宽内存 (HBM) 快几个数量级，但容量却小得多Modern GPUs expose a deep memory hierarchy that trades capacity for bandwidth and latency. On-chip resources (registers, shared memory, and L1 cache) are shared within an SM and are orders of magnitude faster than global High-Bandwidth Memory (HBM), yet has much smaller capacity(NVIDIA, )。由于峰值计算吞吐量的增长速度快于 HBM 带宽的增长速度，许多内核越来越受到内存流量而非算术吞吐量的限制，因此片上内存的有效重用变得至关重要。实现高性能通常需要（i）合并全局内存访问，（ii）足够的并行性以隐藏内存延迟，以及（iii）仔细使用片上存储以部分减少和重用经常访问的变量。. As peak compute throughput has grown faster than HBM bandwidth, many kernels are increasingly limited by memory traffic rather than arithmetic throughput, making effective reuse in on-chip memory critical. Achieving high performance typically requires (i) coalesced global memory accesses, (ii) sufficient parallelism to hide memory latency, and (iii) careful use of on-chip storage for partial reductions and reuse of frequently-accessed variables.

屋顶线和算术强度。Roofline and arithmetic intensity.推断 GPU 性能的一种便捷方法是 Roofline 模型A convenient way to reason about GPU performance is the Roofline model(Williams et al., 2009)，它将可获得的吞吐量与, which relates attainable throughput to算术强度arithmetic intensity（从 HBM 移出的每字节 FLOP）。 随着 GPU 计算吞吐量的增长速度快于 HBM 带宽的增长，计算受限所需的算术强度也会增加，从而将更多稀疏和不规则的运算符推入内存受限状态。 高强度内核（例如，密集 GEMM）可能受计算限制，而低强度内核通常受带宽限制。 GNN 中使用的大多数稀疏和简化基元表现出较低的算术强度，因此通常受内存限制，此外，中间物化进一步增加了数据移动。(FLOPs per byte moved from HBM). As GPU compute throughput grows faster than HBM bandwidth, the arithmetic intensity required to become compute-bound increases, pushing more sparse and irregular operators into the memory-bound regime. High-intensity kernels (e.g., dense GEMM) can be compute-bound, whereas low-intensity kernels are typically bandwidth-bound. Most sparse and reduction-heavy primitives used in GNNs exhibit low arithmetic intensity and are therefore often memory-bound, moreover, intermediate materialization further increases data movement.

内核融合和中间物化。Kernel fusion and intermediate materialization.加速带宽限制工作负载的标准方法是内核融合：组合多个操作，以便输入从 HBM 加载一次并在寄存器/SRAM 中重复使用A standard way to accelerate bandwidth-bound workloads is kernel fusion: composing multiple operations so that inputs are loaded once from HBM and reused in registers/SRAM(Wei et al., 2021; Chen et al., 2018).

GNN 面临的挑战。Challenges with GNNs.GNN 工作负载将稀疏、不规则的图形访问与密集的每节点/每边特征计算相结合，这引入了一些 GPU 特定的挑战。GNN workloads combine sparse, irregular graph access with dense per-node/per-edge feature computation, which introduces several GPU-specific challenges.

首先，邻域聚合需要从非连续节点索引收集特征，即使特征负载沿特征维度合并，邻域基地址的序列也可能非常不规则，从而降低缓存有效性并增加 TLB/DRAM 压力。此外，在消息传递公式中，中间边缘消息（通常大小为First, neighborhood aggregation requires gathering features from non-contiguous node indices, and even when feature loads are coalesced along the feature dimension, the sequence of neighbor base addresses can be highly irregular, reducing cache effectiveness and increasing TLB/DRAM pressure. Moreover, in message-passing formulations, intermediate edge messages (often of sizeO​(M⋅Dℓ)O(M\cdot D_{\ell})) 可以在聚合之前具体化。这进一步增加了内存流量和峰值激活占用空间，并成为大型图的关键瓶颈。) may be materialized before aggregation. This further increases memory traffic and peak activation footprint, and it becomes a key bottleneck for large graphs.

其次，GNN 层自然需要进行边缘计算，然后进行节点缩减。虽然现代深度学习编译器喜欢Second, GNN layers naturally require an edge-wise computations followed by a node-wise reductions. While modern Deep Learning compilers like火炬编译torch.compile非常强大，在这种交替的工作流程中有效的融合很复杂are very powerful, effective fusion is complicated in this alternating workflow(Zhang et al., 2021; Li et al., 2021; Dao et al., 2022; Paszke et al., 2019).

这些特性促进了 IO 感知内核设计，(i) 减少中间物化，(ii) 在可能的情况下通过平铺和融合增加片上重用，以及 (iii) 明确考虑工作到 GPU 线程映射中的程度偏差和布局敏感性。These characteristics motivate IO-aware kernel designs that (i) reduce intermediate materialization, (ii) increase on-chip reuse via tiling and fusion where possible, and (iii) explicitly account for degree skew and layout sensitivity in the mapping of work to GPU threads.

3.1 基于度数缩减的卷积聚合Degree-aware reduction-based convolutions aggregation

真实的图表现出重尾的度分布，导致每个节点统一处理时负载不平衡Real graphs exhibit heavy-tailed degree distributions, causing load imbalance when each node is processed uniformly(Albert and Barabási, 2002; Newman, 2003)。 我们将节点划分为. We partition nodes into光light和and重heavy按节点度阈值（通常是度分布中的某个上分位数）划分子集。subsets by a node degree threshold (which is typically some upper quantile from the degree distribution).光Light节点使用具有合并内存访问模式的功能并行内核（每个节点一个块）。对于nodes use a feature-parallel kernel (one block per node) with coalesced memory access pattern. For重heavy节点上，我们引入了平铺来减少边缘块：每个线程块计算其块上的局部减少。部分结果通过打包 64 位（值、索引）对上的原子操作进行合并，从而使单个原子操作能够向后更新缩减值和源节点索引。向后传递存储源节点索引并将梯度传播实现为稀疏分散相加。nodes, we introduce tiling for reduction over edge chunks: each thread block computes a local reduction over its chunk. Partial results are merged via atomic operations on packed 64-bit (value, index) pairs, enabling a single atomic operation to update both the reduction value and the source node index for backward. The backward pass stores the source node indices and implements gradient propagation as a sparse scatter-add.

的记忆模式为The memory pattern ofO​(M⋅D)O(M\cdot D)加载的字节被保留，因为这些减少具有非常低的算术强度并且基本上是带宽限制的。因此，我们的设计针对的是低效率的主要根源：高度（bytes loaded is preserved, since these reductions have very low arithmetic intensity and are fundamentally bandwidth-bound. Our design, therefore targets the dominant source of inefficiency: high-degree (重heavy）节点，其中每节点一个块的映射未充分利用 GPU。通过将它们的邻域平铺成块，我们增加了内存级并行性并改善了负载平衡，同时保持了相同的渐近 I/O。附录中提供了更广泛的描述) nodes, where a one-block-per-node mapping underutilizes the GPU. By tiling their neighborhoods into chunks, we increase memory-level parallelism and improve load balance while keeping the same asymptotic I/O. Broader description is provided in AppendixD.1.

3.2 基于注意力的层：Graph Transformers 和 GATv2 的融合 CSR 注意力Attention-based layers: fused CSR attention for Graph Transformers and GATv2

基于注意力的 GNN 层通常会具体化边缘逻辑或大小的消息Attention-based GNN layers typically materialize edge-wise logits or messages of sizeO​(M⋅H)O(M\cdot H) or O​(M⋅H⋅D)O(M\cdot H\cdot D)分别是，其中respectively, whereHH是头的数量。这会增加 HBM 流量和激活足迹。我们设计了融合的 CSR 内核，它在对邻居的单个流传递中执行分数计算、softmax 归一化和值聚合，避免了显式边缘张量物化。is the number of heads. This increases HBM traffic and activation footprint. We design fused CSR kernels that perform score computation, softmax normalization, and value aggregation in a single streaming pass over neighbors, avoiding explicit edge tensor materialization.

关键技术是在线 softmax：每个 warp 在寄存器中维护运行统计数据，并在处理新邻居时增量地重新调整输出累加器，从而实现正确的标准化，而无需存储每个边缘的逻辑。The key technique is online softmax: each warp maintains running statistics in registers and rescales the output accumulator incrementally as new neighbors are processed, enabling correct normalization without storing per-edge logits.

对于后向传递，遵循 FlashAttention-2 策略For the backward pass, following the FlashAttention-2 strategy(Dao, 2023)，我们只存储紧凑的每节点 softmax 大小统计数据, we store only compact per-node softmax statistics of sizeO​(N⋅H)O(N\cdot H)，而不是具体化大小的边缘注意力权重, rather than materializing edge-wise attention weights of sizeO​(M⋅H)O(M\cdot H)。这减少了峰值激活内存并实现了有效的重新计算方案，在该方案中我们仅重新评估逻辑并动态导出注意力权重。我们为点积注意力（图变换器）和 GATv2 提供融合内核；实施细节见附录. This reduces peak activation memory and enables an efficient recomputation scheme in which we re-evaluate only the logits and derive attention weights on the fly. We provide fused kernels for both dot-product attention (Graph Transformers) and GATv2; implementation details are in AppendixD.2.

3.3 Tensor Core 利用的块稀疏布局Block-sparse layouts for Tensor Core utilization

虽然我们的融合 CSR 内核消除了边缘物化，但它们依赖于标量核心和不规则聚集模式。为了利用 Tensor Core，我们扩展了块稀疏格式While our fused CSR kernels eliminate edge materialization, they rely on scalar cores and irregular gather patterns. To leverage Tensor Cores, we extend the block-sparse format fromLi and Chandramowlishwaran (2025)为了支持加权邻接矩阵，将本地邻域打包成固定大小的 16to support weighted adjacency matrices, packing local neighborhoods into fixed-size 16×\times16 块与 WMMA 指令兼容。这会牺牲对填充条目的预处理和计算，以获得更高的算术强度和更好的硬件利用率。我们将此格式称为加权块稀疏 (WSB)，因为它支持边权重。 当行窗口表现出足够的局部密度时，这种方法最有效；对于非常稀疏的图，屏蔽计算可以主导并消除 Tensor Core 的优势16 tiles compatible with WMMA instructions. This trades preprocessing and computation on padded entries for higher arithmetic intensity and better hardware utilization. We call this format Weighted Block Sparse (WSB) as it supports edge weights. This approach is most effective when row windows exhibit sufficient local density; for very sparse graphs, masked computations can dominate and eliminate the Tensor Core benefit(Xiang et al., 2025; Li and Chandramowlishwaran, 2025)。 在初步实验中，我们发现有向图的后向延迟对于块稀疏格式来说效率低下，因为它需要以块稀疏格式形成转置并使用原子，这在很大程度上抵消了前向加速。因此，在我们的 WSB 设置中，我们通过 SpMM 原语计算向后传递。实施细则见附录. In preliminary experiments, we found that backward latency for directed graphs is inefficient for block-sparse format, as it requires forming the transpose in the block-sparse format and the use of atomics, which largely negates the forward speedups. Therefore, in our WSB setting we compute the backward pass via a SpMM primitive. Implementation details can be found in AppendixD.3.

3.4 基于 SpMM 的卷积SpMM-based convolutions

鉴于供应商库的成熟度，我们使用 cuSPARSE SpMM 作为主要后端，并专注于最小化辅助开销。我们还缓存特定于图的元数据（cuSPARSE 描述符、预先计算的标准化权重、工作区缓冲区）并支持跨算法变体的自动调整，在训练迭代中分摊设置成本；我们还可以选择缓存预先计算的转置邻接矩阵以进行向后传递，并评估这如何影响运行时延迟和内存占用。此外，我们使用第 1 节中描述的相同加权块稀疏格式提供 Tensor Core SpMM 内核Given the maturity of vendor libraries, we use cuSPARSE SpMM as the primary backend and focus on minimizing auxiliary overhead. We additionally cache graph-specific metadata (cuSPARSE descriptors, precomputed normalized weights, workspace buffers) and support autotuning across algorithm variants, amortizing setup costs across training iterations; we also optionally cache precomputed transposed adjacency matrix for backward pass and evaluate how this affects the runtime latency and memory footprint. Additionally, we provide Tensor Core SpMM kernels using the same weighted block-sparse format described in Section3.3，启用 Tensor Core 加速。, enabling Tensor Core acceleration.

4 实验Experiments

设置。Setup.

由于额外的假设和工程限制，并非所有第三方系统都可以在每个数据集上进行评估。 特别是，DF-GNN 仅在我们的基准套件中的 8 个图上成功执行。 Fused3S 无法为多个大型数据构建所需的块稀疏表示Not all third-party systems could be evaluated on every dataset due to additional assumptions and engineering constraints. In particular, DF-GNN successfully executed only on 8 graphs in our benchmark suite. Fused3S could not build its required block-sparse representation for several large网络主题web-topics图，即使构造成功，我们也观察到非法内存访问导致运行时失败。 此外，发布的 Fused3S 代码没有提供训练的后向实现，因此我们认为它不适合用于训练的端到端替代。 最后，cuGraph 的注意力算子需要二分图来支持具有不同左/右节点特征的层（如 GATv2 中）并匹配 Graph Transformer 接口；由于我们的注意力基准使用非二分图，因此未报告 cuGraph 注意力基线。我们在附录中提供了额外的实验graph, and even when construction succeeded we observed illegal memory access leading to runtime failures. Moreover, the released Fused3S code does not provide a backward implementation for training, so we argue that it is not suitable for end-to-end alternative for training. Finally, cuGraph’s attention operators require a bipartite graph to support layers with distinct left/right node features (as in GATv2) and to match the Graph Transformer interface; since our attention benchmarks use non-bipartite graphs, cuGraph attention baselines are not reported. We provide additional experiments in AppendixB.

5 结论和未来的工作Conclusion and Future Work

我们从以 IO 和算术强度为中心的角度研究 GNN 性能，并表明广泛使用的层聚集成三个具有明显瓶颈的内核系列：基于 SpMM 的卷积、基于缩减的聚合和基于注意力的层。在此分类法的基础上，我们开发了 GPU 实现，可减少冗余 HBM 流量、改善局部性并在真实图形上保持稳健性。特别是，我们的融合注意力内核避免了实现边缘中间体，并大大减少了前向和后向的峰值激活记忆，而度感知平铺则提高了重尾度分布下约简算子的吞吐量。对于基于 SpMM 的层，我们强调供应商原语仍然是强大的基线：通过图形感知缓存和向后缓存转置，cuSPARSE 可以匹配或超越我们设置中的专用系统。我们还探索了一种块稀疏 Tensor-Core 路径，可以提高局部密集图上的前向吞吐量；然而，对于有向图，由于分散/原子积累，其训练时间向后可能会降低效率，这可能会主导增益。最后，我们重新审视图形重新排序并表明其影响是We study GNN performance from an IO- and arithmetic-intensity–centric perspective and show that widely used layers cluster into three kernel families with distinct bottlenecks: SpMM-based convolutions, reduction-based aggregations, and attention-based layers. Building on this taxonomy, we develop GPU implementations that reduce redundant HBM traffic, improve locality, and remain robust on realistic graphs. In particular, our fused attention kernels avoid materializing edge-wise intermediates and substantially reduce peak activation memory in both forward and backward, while degree-aware tiling improves throughput for reduction operators under heavy-tailed degree distributions. For SpMM-based layers, we highlight that vendor primitives remain a strong baseline: with graph-aware caching and a cached transpose for backward, cuSPARSE can match or outperform specialized systems in our setting. We also explore a block-sparse Tensor-Core path that can improve forward throughput on locally dense graphs; however, for directed graphs its training-time backward can be less efficient due to scatter/atomic accumulation, which can dominate the gains. Finally, we revisit graph reordering and show that its impact is不not通用性：它取决于内核的并行化策略、内存访问模式和有效工作集，收集敏感的邻居并行映射比特征并行映射更一致地受益。universal: it depends on the kernel’s parallelization strategy, memory access pattern and effective working set, with gather-sensitive neighbor-parallel mappings benefiting more consistently than feature-parallel ones.

下一步，基于图统计数据（度数倾斜、局部密度、特征大小）在后端（例如 cuSPARSE 与自定义内核、CSR 融合与块稀疏 Tensor-Core 路径）之间进行选择的自适应运行时/自动调整器将使性能更加可预测并减少手动调整。另一个有希望的方向是通过减少向后的散射/原子压力来提高 Tensor-Core 变体的训练时间效率，特别是对于有向图。最后，我们将我们的实现作为轻量级依赖堆栈（CUDA/PyTorch 和可选的 cuSPARSE）的直接替代品发布，从而在实践中实现可重复的、硬件感知的 GNN 加速。As a next step, an adaptive runtime/autotuner that selects between backends (e.g., cuSPARSE vs. custom kernels, CSR-fused vs. block-sparse Tensor-Core paths) based on graph statistics (degree skew, local density, feature size) would make performance more predictable and reduce manual tuning. Another promising direction is improving the training-time efficiency of Tensor-Core variants by reducing scatter/atomic pressure in backward, especially for directed graphs. Finally, we release our implementations as drop-in replacements with a lightweight dependency stack (CUDA/PyTorch and optional cuSPARSE), enabling reproducible, hardware-aware GNN acceleration in practice.

影响报告Impact Statement

本文提出的工作旨在推动机器领域的发展 学习。我们的工作有许多潜在的社会后果，但没有 我们认为这里必须特别强调这一点。This paper presents work whose goal is to advance the field of Machine Learning. There are many potential societal consequences of our work, none which we feel must be specifically highlighted here.

B.1 注意力内核的度感知扭曲分配Degree-Aware Warp Allocation for Attention Kernels

节中介绍的程度感知分区The degree-aware partitioning introduced in Section3.1自然适用于注意力内核。当图内度数方差较高时，分配给高度节点的线程块比分配给低度节点的线程块运行时间要长得多，从而产生尾延迟和 SM 未充分利用。我们在融合注意力内核上测试了这个扩展：目标节点被划分为轻型和重型存储桶，每个存储桶都以独立配置的扭曲计数启动。表applies naturally to attention kernels. When intra-graph degree variance is high, thread blocks assigned to high-degree nodes run substantially longer than those for low-degree nodes, creating tail latency and SM underutilization. We test this extension on our fused attention kernels: destination nodes are partitioned into light and heavy buckets, and each bucket launches with an independently configured warp count. Table5报告了该变体相对于 Graph Transformer 和 GATv2 的原始程度不可知注意内核的加速（head dimreports the speedup of this variant over the original degree-agnostic attention kernel for Graph Transformer and GATv2 (head dim=512=512, H=4H=4头）。加速比与度偏度相关：heads). The speedup correlates with degree skewness:网络流量web-traffic（偏度738）和(skewness 738) andogbn-arxiv（偏度 111）产生最高的增益，而具有接近均匀程度分布的道路网络图显示出最小的改进。 GT 后向收益较少，因为(skewness 111) yield the highest gains, while road-network graphs with near-uniform degree distributions show minimal improvement. GT backward benefits less, as原子添加atomicAdd on d​KdK引入序列化，无论扭曲数量如何。introduces serialization regardless of warp count.

B.2 无向图的方向感知后向核Direction-Aware Backward Kernels for Undirected Graphs

对于无向图，后向传递可以遍历前向传递中使用的相同 CSR 结构，从而消除了转置邻接上的分散/原子操作，这些操作主导了 WSB 的有向向后。我们为 CSR 融合后端和 WSB 后端开发专用的方向感知后向内核，在可用时利用无向性。表For undirected graphs, the backward pass can traverse the same CSR structure used in the forward pass, eliminating the scatter/atomic operations over a transposed adjacency that dominate the directed backward for WSB. We develop dedicated direction-aware backward kernels for both the CSR-fused and WSB backends that exploit undirectedness when available. Table6报告定向后向基线上的加速比（头昏暗）reports the speedup over the directed backward baseline (head dim=128=128, H=4H=4头）。基于 CSR 的 GT 后向从这种优化中获得了 5-21% 的增益，因为消除了转置遍历改善了局部性。 WSB 达到中位数heads). CSR-based GT backward gains 5–21% from this optimization, as eliminating the transposed traversal improves locality. WSB achieves a median7.4×7.4\times加速，因为消除行窗口中的分散/原子争用完全恢复了张量核心在向后方面的优势，而这是有向图所失去的。对于无向图上的 GATv2，我们另外将源特征和目标特征的梯度计算融合到单个内核通道中，从而消除了一次完整的图遍历。所有后端都会针对定向实现产生数值上相同的梯度。speedup, since removing scatter/atomic contention across row windows fully recovers the Tensor Core advantage in backward that is lost for directed graphs. For GATv2 on undirected graphs, we additionally fuse the gradient computation with respect to source and destination features into a single kernel pass, eliminating one full graph traversal. All backends produce numerically identical gradients to the directed implementation.

B.3 WSB 预处理成本和摊销WSB Preprocessing Cost and Amortization

WSB 格式构建会产生每个图结构的一次性预处理成本，该成本必须在训练迭代中摊销。通过将 WSB 表示序列化到磁盘以便跨运行重用，也可以完全消除此成本。桌子WSB format construction incurs a one-time preprocessing cost per graph structure that must be amortized across training iterations. This cost can also be eliminated entirely by serializing the WSB representation to disk for reuse across runs. Table7报告 WSB 构建时间、相对于 DGL 的每历元训练延迟以及由此产生的盈亏平衡历元计数（GT、4 层、head dimreports WSB construction time, per-epoch training latency relative to DGL, and the resulting break-even epoch count (GT, 4 layers, head dim=128=128, H=4H=4头）。在局部密集图上，例如heads). On locally dense graphs such ashm-价格hm-prices（盈亏平衡：65 个时期）和(break-even: 65 epochs) andavazu-ctr（收支平衡：159 个时期）WSB 摊销速度很快，并且更适合实际训练运行。然而，在 16 个图中的 9 个中，CSR 融合后端每个周期的速度更快，并且盈亏平衡超过 1000 个周期，这与 WSB 是局部密集图的可选加速路径而不是通用替代品一致。(break-even: 159 epochs) WSB amortizes quickly and becomes preferable for realistic training runs. On 9 of 16 graphs, however, the CSR-fused backend is faster per epoch and the break-even exceeds 1000 epochs, consistent with WSB being an optional acceleration path for locally dense graphs rather than a universal replacement.

网络欺诈web-fraud, 网络主题web-topics, 网络流量web-traffic.

数据集呈现为大型有向网络图（图是共享的）：节点是网站，边代表观察到的网站之间的用户转换。我们使用Datasets are presented as large directed web graph (graph is shared): nodes are websites, edges represent observed user transitions between websites. We use网络流量web-traffic在我们的实验中。in our experiments.

任务有所不同：欺诈检测（二元、不平衡）、主题分类（多类）和流量预测（回归）。The tasks differ: fraud detection (binary, imbalanced), topic classification (multiclass), and traffic prediction (regression).

artnet-观点artnet-views, artnet-exp.

两者共享相同的艺术创作者（友谊）社交图：节点是用户，边连接朋友。 任务：预测用户视图（回归）和预测显式内容创建者（二元分类）。我们使用Both share the same (friendship) social graph of art creators: nodes are users, edges connect friends. Tasks: predict user views (regression) and predict explicit-content creators (binary classification). We useartnet-观点artnet-views在我们的实验中。in our experiments.

城市道路-Mcity-roads-M, 城市道路-Lcity-roads-L.

有向路网图：节点是路段，边表示交通规则下路段之间的可行过渡。任务是预测给定时间每个路段的平均行驶速度（回归）。Directed road-network graphs: nodes are road segments, edges indicate feasible transitions between segments under traffic rules. The task is to predict average travel speed for each segment at a given time (regression).

城市评论city-reviews.

来自评论服务的用户图：节点是用户，边连接经常评论同一组织的用户。 任务：检测欺诈性审稿人（二元分类）。User graph from a review service: nodes are users, edges connect users who often review the same organizations. Task: detect fraudulent reviewers (binary classification).

avazu-ctr.

根据 Avazu CTR 竞赛数据构建的图：节点是设备，无向边连接经常访问相同网站的设备。 任务：预测设备点击率（回归）。Graph built from Avazu CTR competition data: nodes are devices, undirected edges connect devices that often visit the same websites. Task: predict device CTR (regression).

引文网络Citation-networks(Yang et al., 2016).

科拉cora, 引用者citeseer, 和, and出版医学pubmed是半监督节点分类中使用的经典引用网络。 在 Planetoid 设置中，节点是具有词袋特征的文档，边代表引用链接（对称），目标是将文档分类。我们将它们视为小规模的健全性检查，而不是代表性的扩展基准。are classic citation networks used in semi-supervised node classification. In the Planetoid setup, nodes are documents with bag-of-words features and edges represent citation links (symmetrized), and the goal is to classify documents into classes. We treat them as small-scale sanity checks rather than representative scaling benchmarks.

图形表示和预处理开销。Graph representations and preprocessing overhead.

图形格式和表示开销。Graph formats and representation overhead.

不同的后端需要不同的图形编码和预处理，这甚至在考虑节点特征和中间激活之前也会影响 GPU 内存占用。 表Different backends require different graph encodings and preprocessing, which affects the GPU memory footprint even before accounting for node features and intermediate activations. Table9报告每个后端使用的缓存/预处理图形对象的内存 (MB)。 基于 CSR 的后端（DGL、PyG、cuSPARSE 和我们的 CSR 融合内核）存储行偏移和列索引，可选地包含边缘值，因此在大多数数据集中具有可比较的表示大小。 在 cuSPARSE 中缓存向后的转置邻接（“cuSPARSE +reports the memory (MB) of the cached/preprocessed graph objects used by each backend. CSR-based backends (DGL, PyG, cuSPARSE, and our CSR-fused kernels) store row offsets and column indices, optionally with edge values, and therefore have comparable representation sizes across most datasets. Caching a transposed adjacency for backward in cuSPARSE (“cuSPARSE +A⊤~\tilde{A^{\top}}”）按预期增加表示记忆，例如，”) increases representation memory as expected, e.g., from184.36184.36兆字节至MB to203.72203.72MB 开启MB onogbn-arxiv，并从, and from496.16496.16兆字节至MB to626.39626.39MB 开启MB onpokec-地区pokec-regions.

我们的 Tensor-Core 路径使用加权块稀疏 (WSB) 布局，它会牺牲额外的结构内存（由于阻塞/填充和图块元数据）以获得更高的算术强度和 Tensor Core 利用率。 因此，在密集或局部密集图上，WSB 可能比 CSR 昂贵得多，例如，Our Tensor-Core path uses a weighted block-sparse (WSB) layout, which trades extra structure memory (due to blocking/padding and tile metadata) for higher arithmetic intensity and Tensor Core utilization. Consequently, WSB can be substantially more expensive than CSR on dense or locally dense graphs, e.g.,hm-价格hm-prices (246.32246.32cuSPARSE 中的 MB 与 cuSPARSE 中的 MBMB in cuSPARSE vs.1640.981640.98我们的 MB（WSB/TC））和MB in Ours (WSB/TC)) andtolokers-2 (12.0612.06MB 对比MB vs.80.0980.09MB）。 在非常大的稀疏图上，相对于已经很大的 CSR 足迹，开销更加适中，例如，MB). On very large sparse graphs, the overhead is more moderate relative to the already large CSR footprint, e.g.,网络流量web-traffic (13112.9113112.91cuSPARSE 中的 MB 与 cuSPARSE 中的 MBMB in cuSPARSE vs.13860.1313860.13我们的 MB（WSB/TC））。 最后，对于某些数据集，Fused3S 无法构建其所需的块稀疏表示（标记为MB in Ours (WSB/TC)). Finally, for some datasets Fused3S fails to build its required block-sparse representation (marked as不适用N/A表中in Table9），强调格式要求不仅会影响内存，还会影响评估管道的稳健性。), highlighting that format requirements can affect not only memory but also the robustness of the evaluation pipeline.

对于轻节点，我们采用一种简单而高效的映射，其中每个 CUDA 块都分配给一个目标节点，并且线程在特征维度上进行迭代。 具体来说，每个线程处理特征的跨步子集，并且对于每个特征对邻居列表执行顺序扫描以更新运行最小值和相应的源索引。 这种映射将每个线程的状态保存在寄存器中并避免线程间同步，这在程度适中且邻居扫描不主导端到端运行时时有效。For light nodes, we adopt a simple and efficient mapping where each CUDA block is assigned to one destination node and threads iterate over the feature dimension. This mapping keeps per-thread state in registers and avoids inter-thread synchronization, which is effective when degrees are moderate and the neighbor scan does not dominate end-to-end runtime.

要启用正确的To enable a correct原子最小atomicMin为了减少浮点值，我们将 IEEE-754 浮点数转换为保序无符号整数表示形式。每个值的位模式都被重新映射，以便标准无符号整数比较反映浮点数的总排序：负值按位反转，而非负值则设置其符号位。此转换确保在无符号比较下较小的浮点值始终对应于较小的整数键。 生成的 32 位密钥与源节点索引一起打包成单个 64 位字，其中值密钥占据最高有效位。 正在申请reduction over floating-point values, we transform IEEE-754 floats into an order-preserving unsigned integer representation. The bit pattern of each value is remapped such that the standard unsigned integer comparison reflects the total ordering of floating-point numbers: negative values are bitwise inverted, while non-negative values have their sign bit set. This transformation ensures that a smaller floating-point value always corresponds to a smaller integer key under unsigned comparison. The resulting 32-bit key is packed together with the source node index into a single 64-bit word, with the value key occupying the most significant bits. Applying原子最小atomicMin因此，对该打包表示执行字典式缩减：首先比较值，然后使用源索引来确定性地打破关系。这使得正确的全局to this packed representation therefore performs a lexicographic reduction: values are compared first, and source indices are used to break ties deterministically. 基于注意力的 GNN 层（图变换器和 GAT 系列）在 GPU 上尤其具有挑战性，因为简单的消息传递实现通常会实现边缘注意力逻辑和/或大小的消息Attention-based GNN layers (Graph Transformers and GAT-family) are particularly challenging on GPUs because a straightforward message-passing implementation typically materializes edge-wise attention logits and/or messages of sizeO​(M⋅H)O(M\cdot H) or O​(M⋅H⋅D)O(M\cdot H\cdot D)然后在目标节点减少它们。这种中间实现增加了 HBM 流量和峰值激活足迹，并且由于交替的边缘并行（类似 SDMMM）和节点并行（类似 SpMM）阶段而放大了内核启动开销。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了融合的、IO 感知的 CUDA 内核，以 CSR 格式在邻居之间进行流式传输并执行before reducing them at destination nodes. This intermediate materialization increases HBM traffic and peak activation footprint, and it amplifies kernel-launch overhead due to alternating edge-parallel (SDDMM-like) and node-parallel (SpMM-like) phases. To address this, we design fused, IO-aware CUDA kernels that stream over neighbors in CSR format and perform分数计算、softmax 归一化和值聚合score computation, softmax normalization, and value aggregation在单个内核中，避免显式边缘张量具体化。within a single kernel, avoiding explicit edge tensor materialization.

WSB 何时提供帮助？When does WSB help?

当行窗口表现出足够的局部密度和/或重复使用时，WSB 是最有效的，从而可以降低收集成本WSB is most effective when row windows exhibit sufficient local density and/or reuse so that the cost of gathering1616源列按密集摊销source columns is amortized by the dense16×1616\times 16计算。 如果窗口极其稀疏（每个窗口几乎没有真正的边缘）compute. If windows are extremely sparse (few true edges per16×1616\times 16块），该方法可能会浪费屏蔽条目上的计算并增加预处理和填充开销，从而减少或消除 Tensor Core 的优势。 因此，我们将 WSB 视为可选的加速路径，并评估其对图结构、度偏斜和排序的敏感性。block), the approach may waste compute on masked entries and increase preprocessing and padding overhead, reducing or eliminating the Tensor Core benefit. We therefore treat WSB as an optional acceleration path and evaluate its sensitivity to graph structure, degree skew, and ordering.

WSB 的 IO/FLOP 视角。IO/FLOPs perspective for WSB.

在 CSR 融合注意力内核中，每条边在目标向量和邻居向量之间贡献独立的点积。 这暴露了有限的重用In the CSR fused attention kernel, each edge contributes an independent dot product between a destination vector and a neighbor vector. This exposes limited reuse ofK/QK/Q跨边缘，并且由于不规则的聚集，计算很大程度上受内存限制。 相比之下，WSB 将社区划分为across edges, and the computation is largely memory-bound due to irregular gathers. In contrast, WSB packs neighborhoods into16×1616\times 16图块，使 Tensor Core matmuls 能够在图块中重复使用数据。tiles, enabling Tensor Core matmuls that reuse data across the tile.

计算。Compute.对于 Graph Transformer，单个 WSB 图块对计算For Graph Transformer, a single WSB tile pair computesS=Qwin​Kblk⊤S=Q_{\mathrm{win}}K_{\mathrm{blk}}^{\top}与with16⋅16⋅D16\cdot 16\cdot D每个头的乘法加法（加上值更新），无论实际存在多少条边（屏蔽条目稍后设置为multiply-adds per head (plus the value update), regardless of how many edges are actually present (masked entries are later set to−∞-\infty）。 让). Letρ∈[0,1]\rho\in[0,1]表示平均边缘密度denote the average edge density within the16×1616\times 16蒙面瓷砖。 与 CSR（其执行的工作量与真实边数成正比）相比，WSB 可以将计算量增加大约一个因子masked tile. Compared to CSR, which performs work proportional to the number of true edges, WSB can increase compute by roughly a factor of1/ρ1/\rho由于屏蔽计算，同时受益于 Tensor Core 吞吐量和数据重用。due to masked computations, while benefiting from Tensor Core throughput and data reuse.

HBM 流量。HBM traffic.CSR 和 WSB 最终都必须加载参与节点的功能。 WSB 还存储紧凑的结构元数据（列列表和位图），并且对于加权 SpMM，密集Both CSR and WSB must ultimately load the participating node features. WSB additionally stores compact structural metadata (column lists and bitmaps) and, for weighted SpMM, dense16×816\times 8重量瓷砖。 WSB 减少了具体化每条边张量的需要，并且可以减少每条潜在边的索引开销（位图与显式边列表），但在加载填充列时可能会增加特征流量。 总体而言，WSB 应主要被视为算术强度优化，而不是纯粹的 IO 减少技术。weight tiles. WSB reduces the need to materialize per-edge tensors and can reduce index overhead per potential edge (bitmap vs explicit edge list), but it may increase feature traffic when padded columns are loaded. Overall, WSB should be viewed primarily as an arithmetic-intensity optimization rather than a pure IO-reduction technique.

存储开销。Storage overhead.

请注意，各TCB商店For attention, each TCB stores88列索引（32 字节）和 128 位位图（16 字节），即每个 48 字节元数据column indices (32 bytes) and a 128-bit bitmap (16 bytes), i.e., 48 bytes of metadata per16×816\times 8块（覆盖 128 个潜在边）。 对于加权 SpMM，每个 TCB 还存储一个密集的block (covering 128 potential edges). For weighted SpMM, each TCB additionally stores a dense16×816\times 8权重图块（128 个标量）。 当行窗口足够密集并在迭代中重用时，该开销会被摊销；否则，相对于 CSR，填充会增加内存占用。weight tile (128 scalars). This overhead is amortized when row windows are sufficiently dense and reused across iterations; otherwise, padding can increase memory footprint relative to CSR.

限制以及张量核心何时无济于事。Limitations and when Tensor Cores do not help.

WSB/TCB 路径将不规则稀疏计算换成密集计算The WSB/TCB path trades irregular sparse compute for dense16×1616\times 16瓦片矩阵乘法，其好处主要取决于每块瓦片的有效密度。 当行窗口非常稀疏时（小tile matmuls, and its benefit depends critically on the effective density of each tile. When row windows are very sparse (smallρ\rho），内核仍然执行密集), the kernel still performs denseQ​K⊤QK^{\top}以及随后对许多屏蔽条目进行 matmul 更新，增加了浪费的 FLOP，并且常常再次导致性能内存或开销限制。 WSB 还引入了预处理和填充开销：构造每个窗口唯一的列列表、位图和（对于加权 SpMM）密集and subsequent matmul updates on many masked entries, increasing wasted FLOPs and often making performance memory- or overhead-bound again. WSB also introduces preprocessing and padding overhead: constructing per-window unique column lists, bitmaps, and (for weighted SpMM) dense16×816\times 8权重图块会增加转换时间和存储空间，这必须通过重复的训练/推理步骤进行摊销。 最后，向后传递可能不如向前传递：由于相同的源列可能出现在多个行窗口中，因此更新为weight tiles increases both conversion time and storage, which must be amortized over repeated training/inference steps. Finally, the backward pass can be less favorable than forward: since the same source columns can appear in multiple row windows, updates tod​KdK/d​VdV（并且，对于 SpMM，(and, for SpMM,d​XdX）通常需要原子累积和不规则分散，尽管在内循环中使用 Tensor Core matmuls，但它们仍会主导运行时间并限制可实现的加速。) often require atomic accumulation and irregular scatters, which can dominate runtime and limit the attainable speedup despite using Tensor Core matmuls in the inner loop.

D.4 基于 SpMM 的卷积SpMM-based convolutions

许多广泛使用的 GNN 层（例如 GCN 和 SAGE 风格的聚合）可以表示为稀疏密集矩阵乘法（SpMM），Many widely used GNN layers (e.g., GCN- and SAGE-style aggregations) can be expressed as sparse–dense matrix multiplication (SpMM),Y=A​X,Y=AX,哪里whereAA是稀疏邻接（可选择加权和标准化）并且is a sparse adjacency (optionally weighted and normalized) andX∈ℝN×FX\in\mathbb{R}^{N\times F}是一个稠密的特征矩阵。 鉴于供应商稀疏线性代数的成熟度和强大性能，我们将 NVIDIA cuSPARSE SpMM 作为该算子系列的主要后端，并专注于使其在训练管道中实用且高效。is a dense feature matrix. Given the maturity and strong performance of vendor sparse linear algebra, we treat NVIDIA cuSPARSE SpMM as a primary backend for this operator family and focus on making it practical and efficient inside a training pipeline.

cuSPARSE 集成。cuSPARSE integration.

我们代表We representAA在具有 32 位索引的 CSR 中并为稀疏矩阵创建 cuSPARSE 描述符in CSR with 32-bit indices and create cuSPARSE descriptors for the sparse matrixAA和稠密矩阵and dense matricesB=XB=X和andC=YC=Y。 cuSPARSE 公开了用于 CSR 的多个 SpMM 算法变体（例如，. cuSPARSE exposes multiple SpMM algorithm variants for CSR (e.g.,CUSPARSE_SPMM_CSR_ALG1/2/3），其性能可能因图和特征维度而异。 因此，我们支持显式选择算法或通过轻量级自动调整例程来选择算法，该例程对可用变体进行基准测试并记录给定图的最佳选择。), whose performance can vary across graphs and feature dimensions. We therefore support selecting the algorithm explicitly or via a lightweight autotuning routine that benchmarks the available variants and records the best choice for a given graph.

标准化作为预处理步骤。Normalization as a pre-processing step.

为了支持常见的 GNN 标准化，我们实现了四种模式：To support common GNN normalizations, we implement four modes:无none, 左left, 对right, 和, and两者both。 当启用归一化和/或提供边权重时，我们预先计算节点度并构造与 CSR 对齐的归一化边值数组. When normalization is enabled and/or edge weights are provided, we precompute node degrees and construct a normalized edge-value array aligned with the CSR指数indices。 这会生成一个 float32 边缘值向量，用作 cuSPARSE 稀疏矩阵描述符中的 CSR 值缓冲区。 启用缓存后，度向量和归一化边缘值都会被存储并在后续调用中重用。. This produces a float32 edge-value vector that is used as the CSR value buffer in the cuSPARSE sparse-matrix descriptor. When caching is enabled, both degree vectors and normalized edge values are stored and reused across subsequent calls.

用于重复训练步骤的图结构缓存。Graph-structure cache for repeated training steps.

在典型的 GNN 训练中，图结构是固定的，而 SpMM 在每个时期（以及跨时期）被调用多次，使得一次性预处理和描述符创建值得摊销。 我们实现了一个以 CSR 指针为键的图形缓存（In typical GNN training, the graph structure is fixed while SpMM is invoked many times per epoch (and across epochs), making one-time preprocessing and descriptor creation worth amortizing. We implement a graph cache keyed by the CSR pointers (索引指针indptr, 指数indices）以及归一化模式、边缘权重的存在以及是否使用转置稀疏矩阵。 对于我们存储的每个缓存图： (i) cuSPARSE CSR 矩阵描述符 () together with the normalization mode, the presence of edge weights, and whether the sparse matrix is used transposed. For each cached graph we store: (i) a cuSPARSE CSR matrix descriptor (cusparseSpMatDecr_tcusparseSpMatDescr_t）引用 CSR 结构和（可能标准化的）值， (ii) 预先计算的度向量和归一化边缘值， (iii) 所选的 cuSPARSE SpMM 算法，以及 (iv) cuSPARSE 工作空间缓冲区及其大小。 这避免了重复地重新创建描述符和重新分配工作空间，并且可以在前向和后向传递中重用相同的 cuSPARSE 句柄和图特定的 SpMM 配置。) that references the CSR structure and the (possibly normalized) values, (ii) precomputed degree vectors and normalized edge values, (iii) the selected cuSPARSE SpMM algorithm, and (iv) the cuSPARSE workspace buffer and its size. This avoids repeatedly recreating descriptors and reallocating workspace, and it enables reusing the same cuSPARSE handle and graph-specific SpMM configuration across forward and backward passes.

前向和后向重用。Forward and backward reuse.

对于转发，我们调用For forward, we invoke尖峰SpMMcusparseSpMM在任一on eitherAA or A⊤A^{\top}（由控制(controlled bydo_transpose_a）取决于层配方。 对于向后，可以重用相同的缓存图元数据：相对于输入的梯度对应于乘以转置邻接，即) depending on the layer formulation. For backward, the same cached graph metadata can be reused: gradients with respect to inputs correspond to multiplying by the transposed adjacency, i.e.,d​X=A⊤​d​YdX=A^{\top}\,dY，这是由 cuSPARSE 使用相同的 CSR 结构和缓存工作空间有效处理的。 通过在前向过程中创建和缓存 cuSPARSE 描述符和工作空间，我们减少了后向的开销，并确保在多次迭代中重复使用同一图时的稳定性能。, which is efficiently handled by cuSPARSE using the same CSR structure and cached workspace. By creating and caching the cuSPARSE descriptors and workspace during forward, we reduce overhead in backward and ensure stable performance when the same graph is reused across many iterations.

实际考虑。Practical considerations.

我们的实现使用 32 位 CSR 索引并假设连续的密集特征矩阵。 我们公开 (i) SpMM 算法选择（固定或自动调整），(ii) 归一化模式，(iii) 是否Our implementation uses 32-bit CSR indices and assumes contiguous dense feature matrices. We expose (i) the SpMM algorithm choice (fixed or autotuned), (ii) the normalization mode, (iii) whetherAA转置，以及 (iv) 用于度数和归一化预处理内核的 CUDA 块大小。 我们还提供了一个缓存重置实用程序，用于在对多个图表进行基准测试时控制内存使用情况。is transposed, and (iv) the CUDA block size used in degree and normalization preprocessing kernels. We also provide a cache reset utility to control memory usage when benchmarking multiple graphs.

开销以及为什么缓存很重要。Overheads and why caching matters.

实际上，对于中等特征大小或更小的图，端到端运行时通常不是由 SpMM 内核本身决定，而是由辅助开销决定：度计算和权重归一化、重复描述符构造、查询工作空间大小以及工作空间分配/释放。 通过缓存特定于图的预处理结果（度数和归一化值）以及 cuSPARSE CSR 描述符、选定的算法和工作区缓冲区，我们可以在重复的训练迭代中分摊这些成本。 这将 SpMM 调用变成了近乎纯粹的向前和向后的库调用，使性能更加稳定，并提高了实际训练循环中的吞吐量。In practice, for moderate feature sizes or smaller graphs, end-to-end runtime is often not dominated by the SpMM kernel itself but by auxiliary overheads: degree computation and weight normalization, repeated descriptor construction, querying workspace size, and workspace allocation/free. By caching graph-specific preprocessing results (degrees and normalized values) together with the cuSPARSE CSR descriptor, selected algorithm, and workspace buffer, we amortize these costs across repeated training iterations. This turns SpMM invocation into a near-pure library call in both forward and backward, making performance more stable and improving throughput in realistic training loops.
